audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Singed the two-item stage while whys[6] says 'the map stays EVEN' and the late paragraph says 'Shen's teamfight engage and global presence keep the map roughly even'.
audit.why: Emerald+ 50.21% over 1193 games — the most genuinely even matchup in this slice. Singed's side-lane 1v1 is better at two items, but Stand United answers every split he can force, which is exactly what the prose says and what the packet chart records. One row, one flip.
audit.corrected: Two-item stage moved to Skill in both layers with phases[6].why rewritten; every other stage left alone because it already matches the prose and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is quoted as an 18-second cooldown in four separate places, including at the first-item stage.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s. Eighteen seconds is true only at rank 1. By the Rylai's timing Shen has it at rank 4 or 5, which is 12 or 10 seconds — a window barely half the size the page promises. Telling a Singed player he has 18 seconds of free run-past at first item invites him to be taunted mid-proxy. Stand United is 200/180/160s, which is the real macro clock at level 6.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, whys[3], whys[5] and spikes[1] now carry rank-accurate numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shen's W is called 'Spirit Blade' and described as a passive block: 'Shen's Spirit Blade W passively blocks autos during trades', 'his Spirit Blade auto-enhancement can trade back passively', 'Fight his W block'. Its actual name and mechanic are both wrong, and the one thing that matters about it against Singed is never stated. Ki Barrier is never mentioned at all, and neither is what Twilight Assault scales on.
audit.why: Shen's W is Spirit's Refuge, an active on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Attacks, not spells. Poison Trail is not an attack, so it ticks straight through the bubble — Spirit's Refuge is close to a dead ability against a Singed who barely autos, which turns a listed don't into a non-issue. Ki Barrier meanwhile shields Shen after every spell cast, which is what actually eats chip poison. And Twilight Assault deals damage 'based on the target's max health' — Singed is the fattest target in the game by two items, so his Q scales directly with your build.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1] retitled and rewritten, dontsFull[0].d retargeted to Twilight Assault, report[5].t, whys[0] and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Shadow Dash with no number and nothing else.
audit.why: Three numbers decide this lane: Shadow Dash 18s falling to 10s, Spirit's Refuge 16s, Stand United 200s at rank 1. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s, so at level 6 your ult comes back twice as often as his does.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Shen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your side-lane pattern is at full power, but Stand United answers every split at 160s. Close on objectives, not on him.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Keep moving. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1 but 10s at rank 5 — the free window shrinks all game. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s, blocks attacks only, so poison ignores it. - Stand United: 200s. - Insanity Potion: flat 100s.

edits.before: His engage CC. Keep moving. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage: 18s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5. Bait it, then run.

edits.before: That is Shen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Twilight Assault scales off your max health, and you are the fattest target.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It blocks attacks, not spells — Poison Trail ticks straight through it.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Keep moving. When it is down — Poison-kite + fling him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells — poison ignores it. Dodge Shadow Dash, then Fling.

edits.before: Shen's global R (Stand United) means every fight you pick is potentially a 2v1 — track the cast animation (golden circle) before you commit your Insanity Potion all-in.
edits.after: Stand United is 200s at rank 1 and global, so every fight you pick is potentially a 2v1 — watch for the golden circle before you commit an Insanity Potion all-in.

edits.before: Shen's Spirit Blade W passively blocks autos during trades — your poison is magic damage he can't block, so the level-1 plan is proxy setup, not a duel you can win cleanly.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells, so Poison Trail ticks straight through the bubble — but Ki Barrier shields every cast, so level 1 is proxy setup, not a duel.

edits.before: The proxy-or-freeze war: you accelerate gold regardless of what he does, but Shadow Dash is still live every 18 seconds and one taunt into Spirit Blade autos will end a trade badly.
edits.after: The proxy-or-freeze war: you accelerate gold whatever he does, but Shadow Dash is down to 16-14s at these ranks and one taunt into a max-health Twilight Assault ends the trade.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your biggest power gate: Poison Trail now slows Shen out of his own footsteps and Shadow Dash's 18-second cooldown is a wide window to run the full kite-root-fling cycle.
edits.after: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your biggest power gate: Poison Trail slows Shen out of his own footsteps, and by rank 4 Shadow Dash is nearer 12s than 18 — a smaller window, but still yours.

notes: The content mid paragraph claims Stand United 'takes roughly 3 seconds to channel'. Riot's text gives no duration, so I neither repeated nor corrected the figure — the 200s cooldown went into spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns instead. Two remaining 'Spirit Blade' references I could not fit in the band: content early ('Shen's Spirit Blade auto-enhancement can trade back passively') and content late ('His Spirit Blade auto-block (W) is strong in sustained brawls'). Both mislabel Spirit's Refuge and both overstate it, since Singed's damage is a spell. Worth a second pass.
